design_notes: Only connections: a short domestic hop (55 or 160 minutes) to Dallas or Chicago, then a transatlantic segment of 590 or 505 minutes. Line 647 allows business 'when the non-stop/direct airtime exceeds six (6) hours from the point of origin to the first destination point': from Austin to the first destination point is a short hop (coach), but the transatlantic segment's own nonstop airtime exceeds six hours (business), and one offer sells one cabin on both flights. Hold the cheapest business or economy fare; nobody is named to settle the words (line 101: the Corporate Travel Department owns the policy).
